consentSubtitle: Before you start recording, we need your permission.
consentBulletDatasets: Your voice recordings are uploaded to help build language datasets for African languages.
consentBulletReview: Recordings may be reviewed by people working on the dataset.
consentBulletAnonymous: You will not be identified by name. We only store an anonymous device ID.
consentBulletRevoke: You can revoke this consent later from the app settings; future recordings will stop being uploaded.
consentAgeConfirmLabel: I confirm I'm at least 18 years old, or have a parent or guardian's agreement.
consentWhatIfDeclineBody: AfrikLang missions are voice recordings, so the app can't work without your permission. Nothing is recorded or uploaded until you agree. You can leave now and come back anytime — your path will be waiting.
consentDisclaimer: By tapping "{action}" you confirm you have read the points above.
levelMicPermissionRequired: Microphone permission is required to record.
levelConsentRequiredSnack: Recording consent is required before uploading. Re-enable consent in settings.

progressQueuedSyncFailedSnack: Couldn't sync your progress with the server.
levelSwapPoolExhaustedSnack: No more new words at this level — skipping instead.
levelSwapFailedSnack: Couldn't pick a new word — skipping instead.

levelCompleteEncouragement: Every recording helps build the future of your language.
